answer: An anchor of distant attestations sets standing, not its cluster. A newcomer tends a yarrow bed; an inside vouch weighs almost zero, while a distant one counts full. Rented-distance is the failure: a bought vouch costs 40 credits, and a seller caught backing a fake hits its nadir on a 100-credit slash. Each fake needs 3 vouches: 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 against a 40,000-credit pool; one distant attestation gives an honest agent full weight.
